I have been farming this land in Mulanje for many years, and I know that without fertilizer the maize will not feed my family. I will use the subsidized NPK and urea I was able to get this year, and I will plant the hybrid seed that comes with it. My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting, weeding, and harvest, because we cannot afford to pay hired workers. We have always relied on the rains here in the highlands, and we pull the weeds by hand as we have always done.
